text.en:
After 1.5 seconds of aiming-down-sights (ADS) without firing:
10% increased Aim Assist Falloff Distance and increases Precision Multiplier by +1 for one shot.

Timer starts as soon as the ADS input is pressed.

< table >
| Weapon Frame        | Precision Multiplier Increase <bold/>
| Linear Fusion Rifle | <title 29% [mult1] />         <background/>
| Sniper Rifle        | <title 33.22% [mult0] />   
| Scout Rifle         | <title 62.75% [mult2] />      <background/>
<$>

enhanced (
#e Activation timer is reduced to 1.4 seconds.
)


title mult0 (
3x -> 4x
)

title mult1 (
3.44x -> 4.44x
)

title mult2 (
1.6x -> 2.6x
)
text.zh-chs:
未射击下瞄准 1.5 秒：
+10% 瞄准辅助衰减距离，并提高下一发子弹精准命中伤害（伤害系数+1）。

按下瞄准键即开始计时。

• 10% increased Aim Assist Falloff Distance
• Increases Precision Multiplier by 1 (e.g. 1.5x🠚2.5x)

Timer starts as soon as the ADS input is pressed. Unscoping immediately removes the buff.

Aiming Down Sights for #e${1.5-#d} seconds without firing grants the following for a single shot:
• 10% increased Aim Assist Falloff Distance
• 40% increased precision damage (30% for <heavy/>Heavy Ammo Sniper Rifles)

Timer starts as soon as the ADS input is pressed. Unscoping immediately removes the buff.

The precision damage of Scout Rifles is decreased by 5% while Box Breathing is active. (This part of the perk is inconsistent and often doesn't get applied)

enhanced (
var d = 0.1
#e Activation time is decreased by 0.1 seconds.
)

Aiming Down Sights for #e${1.5-#d} seconds without firing grants the following for a single shot:
• 10% increased Aim Assist Falloff Distance
• 40% increased precision damage (35% for <<primary/>Scout Rifles, 30% for <heavy/>Heavy Ammo Sniper Rifles)

Timer starts as soon as the ADS input is pressed. Unscoping immediately removes the buff.

For glaives (Greasy Luck), the projectile must strike the target's critical hitbox in order to recieve the 40% <pvp [35%] /> damage bonus.
